clips.title: The story
paras: This vial contains a refined extract of the foul fluid that sustains the rot hide gnolls of Silverpine Forest. Distilled down to its base components by Apothecary Renferrel, the substance carries lingering traces of both necromancy and warlock sorcery.

The Rot Hide gnolls that prowl Silverpine Forest are no ordinary beasts. After recovering samples from the creatures and their lingering remnants, Apothecary Renferrel of the Royal Apothecary Society reduced the vile liquid into its constituent elements. His chemical breakdown revealed that the ichor was artificially manufactured through a convergence of dark schools: necromantic rites woven together with warlock magics. Because the craft behind it borders on arcane disciplines outside simple alchemy, Renferrel packaged this sample and dispatched it to the Undercity for Bethor Iceshard to examine with divination.
